comparison.objective: Replace a laser-printer toner cartridge and close the printer door.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-cartridge extraction, square guide-rail insertion, notch seating, obstacle avoidance, and door closure.
comparison.success_condition: Old cartridge is safely placed, new cartridge is seated within specified pose tolerances, door is shut, and arms release; roller contact, drops, excessive tilt, or printer displacement fail.
comparison.reason: This is guided component replacement and seating, not selective loose-body separation or screen agitation. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
